question: The LCM of (18)/(5), (6)/(5) and (18)/(125) is:
solution:
Given:

(18)/(5), (6)/(5) and (18)/(125)

Concept used:

LCM of fractions = { LCM (Numerators) over HCF (Denominators)}

Calculation:

 LCM ((18)/(5), (6)/(5),(18)/(125)) = { LCM (18, 6, 18) over HCF (5, 5, 125)} = {18 over 5} = 3.6

**∴ The LCM of (18)/(5), (6)/(5) and (18)/(125) is 3.6.**
